events.title: Frequency: The Secret of Everything screening and Q&A
events.description: Filmmakers Kaia Roman and Zappy Zapolin investigate emerging frequency technologies alongside leading voices, including Dr. Joe Dispenza, Bruce H. Lipton, Gregg Braden, Lynne McTaggart, Veda Austin, Michael Beckwith, Foster Gamble, Kimberly Carter Gamble, Rollin McCraty, and many more.
